*22 A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones. (Proverbs 17:22 KJV)*

It seems like the average Christian spends a lot of time in exercise and health foods. They think that diets and pills are all that matter to our health, but the Lord is telling us that a merry heart is like a medicine, and that honoring our parents will give us long life (Exodus 20:12). When the peace of God flows over you, it makes you so content that the cares of this world just go away, or become unimportant in comparison to the love of God. If you truly understand and experience the love of God, you will not be worried about your health all the time. If you know the healing power that we have inside us through the atonement of Jesus (1 Peter 2:24), then if the devil does manage to put any sickness on you, all you have to do is let the power of God cure it for you.
